name: Magma Emblem
description: A medal-like item in the same shape as Team Magma's mark.

gifts.note: Reach the top of Mt. Pyre. When you first walk up to Team Aqua's leader Archie at the summit, he runs off with the orb. The old woman who guards it then gives you the Magma Emblem Team Magma left behind. It can't be missed.
